body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Cucumber?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:

- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rccu-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-cucumber">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rccu-page,
    .rccu-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rccu-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rccu-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    .rccu-page a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 10px; }

    .rccu-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rccu-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rccu-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rccu-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rccu-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 30px; }

    .rccu-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rccu-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .rccu-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26); }
    .rccu-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); color: var(--rc-moss); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10); }

    .rccu-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rccu-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rccu-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rccu-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rccu-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rccuFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rccu-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccu-hero-title-overlay .rccu-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rccu-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rccu-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rccu-hero-content { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 34px; align-items: center; padding-top: 44px; }
    .rccu-breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .rccu-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rccu-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccu-hero-subtitle { max-width: 720px; margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem); }

    .rccu-hero-card,
    .rccu-side-card,
    .rccu-panel,
    .rccu-info-card,
    .rccu-step,
    .rccu-benefit,
    .rccu-faq-item {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccu-hero-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 38px; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rccu-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rccu-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccu-hero-card li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rccu-hero-card li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rccu-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }
    .rccu-quickbar-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rccu-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 96px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rccu-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rccu-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rccu-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rccu-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rccu-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rccu-section-header { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rccu-section h2,
    .rccu-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rccu-section-header p { margin: 0 auto; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; max-width: 680px; }
    .rccu-article-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .rccu-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rccu-panel { position: relative; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px); border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); overflow: hidden; }
    .rccu-panel::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 190px; height: 190px; right: -82px; top: -92px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10); pointer-events: none; }
    .rccu-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rccu-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rccu-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccu-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rccu-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rccu-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccu-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 15px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10); color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rccu-list li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rccu-card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccu-info-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rccu-info-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rccu-info-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.2rem; }
    .rccu-info-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; }
    .rccu-info-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccu-warning { padding: 68px 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rccu-warning-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px); border-radius: 42px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); }
    .rccu-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rccu-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }
    .rccu-warning-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccu-warning-list li { padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: #4a2823; font-weight: 800; }
    .rccu-warning-list strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--rc-danger); font-size: 1.05rem; }

    .rccu-image-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: 30px; align-items: center; }
    .rccu-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }
    .rccu-image-card img { position: absolute; object-fit: cover; display: block; border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
    .rccu-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }
    .rccu-img-main { width: 78%; height: 340px; left: 0; top: 20px; border-radius: 42px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .rccu-img-small { width: 52%; height: 230px; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 34px; transform: rotate(4deg); object-fit: contain !important; background: #fff9ef; }

    .rccu-prep { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rccu-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccu-step { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); }
    .rccu-step b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rccu-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rccu-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccu-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rccu-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rccu-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccu-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rccu-side-card a { display: block; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 850; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; }
    .rccu-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rccu-note { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold); color: var(--rc-muted); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rccu-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rccu-benefits-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rccu-benefit { padding: 22px; border-radius: 26px; }
    .rccu-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rccu-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rccu-diet-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rccu-diet-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start; padding: 20px; border-radius: 26px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rccu-diet-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.35rem; }
    .rccu-diet-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rccu-diet-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.98rem; }

    .rccu-faq-grid { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rccu-faq-item { border-radius: 26px; overflow: hidden; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rccu-faq-item summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 20px 22px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 900; }
    .rccu-faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .rccu-faq-item summary::after { content: "+"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; min-width: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900; transition: transform 0.2s ease; }
    .rccu-faq-item[open] summary::after { content: "−"; transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .rccu-faq-item p { margin: 0; padding: 0 22px 22px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1rem; }

    .rccu-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rccu-final-box { padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px); border-radius: 46px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)), url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-cucumber-2.png"); background-size: cover; background-position: center; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); overflow: hidden; }
    .rccu-final-box .rccu-pill,
    .rccu-final-box h2,
    .rccu-final-box p { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
    .rccu-final-box p { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.08rem; }
    .rccu-final-box .rccu-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #2f4a2e; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); text-shadow: none; }

    .rccu-related { padding: 74px 0; background: #fff9ef; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; animation: none !important; }
    .rccu-related,
    .rccu-related * { opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rccu-related .rccu-section-header { padding: 30px; border-radius: 34px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14); }
    .rccu-related .rccu-section-header .rccu-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }
    .rccu-related .rccu-section-header h2 { color: #243320 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rccu-related .rccu-section-header p { color: #332d26 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; font-weight: 650; }
    .rccu-related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rccu-related-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr; gap: 15px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff !important; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; }
    .rccu-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }
    .rccu-related-card img { width: 92px; height: 92px; max-width: 92px; max-height: 92px; border-radius: 20px; object-fit: cover; background: #f1eadf; }
    .rccu-related-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; color: #243320 !important; line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 900; }
    .rccu-related-card p { margin: 0; color: #332d26 !important; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 650; }

    .rccu-disclaimer { padding: 0 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rccu-disclaimer p { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); }


    .rccu-answer-box {
      margin-top: 22px;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff, #fff8eb);
      border: 2px solid rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rccu-answer-box strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rccu-serving-table-wrap {
      margin: 24px 0 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border-radius: 24px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.14);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccu-serving-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      min-width: 620px;
      background: #ffffff;
    }

    .rccu-serving-table th,
    .rccu-serving-table td {
      padding: 16px 18px;
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      vertical-align: top;
    }

            Cucumber should be given in small portions only. For most healthy adult rabbits, a good serving is 1–2 thin slices, offered up to 2–3 times per week.
          </p>
          <p>
            These are cautious treat portions, not daily diet amounts. Too much cucumber can cause soft stools or diarrhoea because of its high water content. Always introduce new foods slowly and monitor your rabbit for digestive changes.
          </p>

              </thead>

                  <td>1–2 times per week</td>

                  <td>2 thin slices</td>
                  <td>Up to 2–3 times per week</td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          <ul class="rccu-list">

            <li>Feed cucumber occasionally, not every day.</li>

        <div>
          <span class="rccu-pill">Potential risks</span>
          <h2>Why cucumber should stay occasional</h2>
          <p>
            While cucumber is safe for many healthy adult rabbits, it is watery and low in fibre. Avoid cucumber if your rabbit already has soft stools, diarrhoea, bloating, reduced appetite, a history of gut problems or is eating less hay than usual.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rccu-warning-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Digestive upset</strong>
            Too much watery food can upset a rabbit’s sensitive digestive system.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Low fibre</strong>
            Cucumber does not provide enough fibre to support healthy gut movement.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Reduced hay appetite</strong>
            If rabbits fill up on treats like cucumber, they may eat less hay.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Vet warning signs</strong>
            If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems hunched, bloated or in pain, contact a rabbit-savvy vet urgently.
          </li>

 <details class="rccu-faq-item">
  <summary>Can rabbits eat or have cucumber?</summary>
  <p>Yes, adult rabbits can eat or have cucumber in small amounts. Cucumber is not toxic, but it is very watery and low in fibre, so it should be an occasional fresh food rather than a main part of their diet. People may also search “can bunnies eat cucumber”, but the advice is the same for adult rabbits.</p>
</details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>Can rabbits eat cucumber skin?</summary>
    <p>Yes, rabbits can usually eat cucumber skin if it is washed well. The skin contains more fibre than the watery middle, but cucumber should still only be offered in small portions.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>Can rabbits eat cucumber seeds?</summary>
    <p>Yes, soft cucumber seeds are usually safe for rabbits. There is no need to remove them from ordinary cucumber slices.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>How much cucumber can rabbits eat?</summary>
    <p>A good serving size is one or two thin slices, offered occasionally. Too much cucumber can cause soft droppings because it is high in water and low in fibre.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>Can rabbits eat cucumber every day?</summary>
    <p>No. Cucumber should not be fed every day. Hay should be the main part of a rabbit’s diet, with fresh foods offered as a smaller part of the routine.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>Can baby rabbits eat cucumber?</summary>

  </details>

  <details class="rccu-faq-item">
    <summary>Can rabbits eat cucumber leaves or flowers?</summary>

  </details>
